FIRST AMENDMENT 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 Deevar Developers (Private) Limited ( refe r red to as “ Developer ” ) and [•] [Buyer/Buyers Names] ( individually, or in the case of joint buyers and collectively referred to as “ Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first amendment (“ First Amendment ”) to Agreement to Sell dated [•] [INSERT DATE] , (“ Agreement ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•] December, 202 2 (“ Effective Date ”) . 
 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement for th e purchase of the apartment more fully described in Description of Uni t of a residential housing project by the Developer , named and styled as ‘ Zameen Opal ’, co nsisting of residential apartments located at Plot 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Project ”); and 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 1 5 . 2 of the Agreement, Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the provisions of this First Amendment. 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as f o l l ows: 
 The First Amendment shall be effective from the Effective Date. 
 The Payment Plan specified in A ttachment B of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced with the Payment Plan specified in Attachment B /1 appended to this First Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, the Payment Plan in Attachment B shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any and all references to Attachment B in the Agreement shall be deemed to be reference to Attachment B /1 appended to this First Amendment . 
 This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis , and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in the First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein. 
 The First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same amendment. 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
